verdict.rationale: Model-based turn-taking is a fair question for a voice-agent platform, but the evidence pack never documents a semantic or model-based end-of-turn detector. The closest item is the transcription-mode doc, which only offers a lower or higher 'endpointing setting' to trade speed against accuracy. That is an adjacent silence-threshold control, not model-based end-of-turn detection.

support.subject: As a developer, I can use model-based end-of-turn detection beyond simple VAD silence timeouts so the agent doesn't talk over slow speakers
